title: Antigravity CLI health history
scope: The dc_router Antigravity CLI route records enough bounded health history to diagnose frequent fallback or circuit-breaker flapping without scraping AstrBot logs.
acceptance_criteria: The health module appends a JSONL event whenever Antigravity succeeds, fails, or is bypassed because its circuit breaker is open.
Each event includes a timestamp, event type, status, availability, failure reason or error code when present, and elapsed seconds for successes.
History writes are best effort and must never break the chat path.
A summary helper reports recent event counts and reason counts from the history file.
Tests cover success, failure, circuit fallback recording, and summary counts using temporary files.
